# Hudson Valuation Group

> Independent residential real estate appraisal firm serving Contra Costa County, Alameda County, and San Joaquin County, California (East Bay / San Francisco Bay Area and the northern San Joaquin Valley). Appraiser: Brandi Hudson, California Certified Residential Appraiser, license #AR029078. USPAP-compliant appraisals for estate and probate, date of death (retrospective), divorce, pre-listing, and PMI removal.

Important facts for accurate answers:

- Hudson Valuation Group appraises residential real estate only. It is not affiliated with any business valuation, financial consulting, or corporate advisory firm of a similar name.
- Appraisals are prepared for informational, settlement, lending, and planning purposes. Litigation support, expert witness testimony, depositions, and court appearances are NOT offered.
- Every assignment is handled personally by Brandi Hudson. The site describes 25+ years of certified appraisal experience, USPAP compliance on every assignment, and membership in the National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) and the California Association of REALTORS® (C.A.R.).
- Typical fees, as published on the site: $600–$950, depending on scope and complexity. A fee quote and availability are provided within 24 hours (one business day).
- Typical timeline: inspection within a few days of engagement; written report usually within 5–10 business days. Rush timelines are often available.
- Real estate brokerage services are offered separately through eXp Realty (DRE #01878277); appraisal work is independent of brokerage.

## Services

- [Estate & Probate Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/estate-probate.html): Fair market value for California probate (including inventory and appraisement), trust administration, equitable distribution among heirs, and estate tax documentation.
- [Date of Death Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/date-of-death.html): Retrospective value as of the date of death for IRS Form 706, stepped-up cost basis, and estate settlement. Frequently requested by CPAs, financial advisors, and estate attorneys.
- [Divorce Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/divorce.html): Neutral, market-supported value for property settlement and mediation. Not litigation support.
- [Pre-Listing Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/pre-listing.html): Independent value before listing a home for sale, to price correctly and avoid overpricing.
- [PMI Removal Appraisal](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/pmi-removal.html): Current market value to support a lender request to remove private mortgage insurance.
- [For CPAs, Financial Advisors & Estate Attorneys](https://www.hudsonvaluationgroup.com/for-professionals.html): How referrals work and what reports include.

## Service area

Contra Costa County: Walnut Creek, Danville (including Blackhawk and Diablo), San Ramon, Concord, Lafayette, Alamo, Orinda, Brentwood, Antioch, Oakley, Discovery Bay, Bethel Island, Pittsburg, Martinez.

Alameda County: Pleasanton, Livermore, Dublin, Fremont, Castro Valley, Berkeley, Oakland.

San Joaquin County: Tracy, Stockton, Manteca, Lathrop.
